basic_info.description: This luminous and beautifully remodeled home at 88 King showcases stunning views of the pool and peek-a-boo of the Bay Bridge. The unit features luxury upgrades, including brand-new diagonal plank authentic wood floors, new light fixtures throughout, a brand new chef's kitchen finished with European cabinetry, Calacatta Gold Quartz countertops, and high-end appliances, including a GE kitchen range and LG microwave. The main bedroom is completed by an ample walk-in closet. The bathrooms come with updated cabinets and LED vanities.The unit comes with 1 car parking and storage. 88 King is a full-service luxury condo building located across the street from the South Beach Marina. The building offers luxurious resort-style amenities, including a heated outdoor pool and spa, a sun deck with a full BBQ, a fire pit, and heat lamps. Residents also enjoy a private fitness center, conference room, business center, and entertainment room. The location is prime: located just a block from the Embarcadero waterfront, Oracle Park and a short walk to the Ferry Building, Chase Center, entertainment & restaurants.
